Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 130: Holiday 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #130 shipped to subscribers in November 2011 (bearing the cover date of Holiday 2011 for Issue 130). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #130 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Binary Domain (third-person tactical shooter)
Syndicate (first-person cyberpunk shooter)
Birds of Steel (combat flight simulator)
Gotham City Impostors (Xbox Live Arcade multiplayer first-person shooter)
Shank 2 (Xbox Live Arcade 2D side-scrolling beat 'em up)
Nexuiz (Xbox Live Arcade arena first-person shooter)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for Mass Effect 3, Halo 4, Ghost Recon: Future Soldier, and Resident Evil 6, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
